actions_or_findings.title: KB008-B1 [CLOSED by inspection]
actions_or_findings.trigger: Two version requests wait on the same document row.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The ordered SELECT FOR UPDATE runs after the document lock and reads the latest committed version under MySQL repeatable read. Concurrency was not exercised.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-B2 [CLOSED for tenant selection]
actions_or_findings.trigger: A SYSTEM grant or mixed-tenant grants select a property.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The ACL uses the property's persisted tenant, checks knowledge:read against that exact scope, and retains property_id=0 for tenant-common knowledge.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-B3 [CLOSED by inspection]
actions_or_findings.trigger: An unauthorized actor requests a version of an archived document.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Persisted-scope permission is checked before KB.ARCHIVED is returned.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-N1 [CLOSED by inspection]
actions_or_findings.trigger: A newer ingestion job is pending while an older version remains active.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The card uses the first job from the descending, version-unique job list; selected history remains intact.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-B4 [BLOCKER] Mixed grants elevate retrieval visibility
actions_or_findings.trigger: An actor has TENANT_ADMIN in tenant 10 and PROPERTY_ADMIN for property 200 in tenant 20, then retrieves property 200.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The new property branch correctly targets tenant 20, but visibility is still derived from all actor roles. The tenant 10 grant adds TENANT visibility to the tenant 20 ACL, whose property IDs include 0. The Milvus filter and MySQL postfilter can therefore admit tenant 20 tenant-common TENANT knowledge. The new mixed-grant test checks tenant and property IDs but does not check visibility.
